To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
hybrid anatomic-functional imaging, regardless of its core components, provides a comprehensive assessment of CAD that is more accurate than either of its core components alone.

hybrid anatomo-functional testing is beneficial irrespective of its components (e.g., coronary CT angiography and myocardial perfusion imaging), and that the combination of anatomic (coronary CT angiography) and functional (stress myocardial perfusion) testing is the best hybrid imaging approach in patients with suspected CAD, and should be considered the standard of care.
hybrid anatomo-functional testing of CAD is beneficial irrespective of its core component.
